title: Review Record Allowance on Military Service Hold Proof Requests
content:
**Truth table — Hardship and Protective Holds.** When current proof of active military duty is asked for before a status review of a running Military Service Hold, the review-record allowance of the status review proof depends on the reviews recorded as continuing the hold. Reviews of this tier fall due every 90 calendar days counted from the hold's start date; the reviews fallen due by today are those whose due date is on or before today. The allowance is added once to the days allowed for the status review proof:

- where every review that has fallen due by today was recorded as continuing the hold and they number at least the steady-review count of 3, the steady-review days, 7 calendar days, are added;
- where every fallen-due review was recorded as continuing it but they number fewer than 3, the early-review days, 3 calendar days, are added;
- where fewer reviews were recorded as continuing the hold than have fallen due, nothing is added.

"Every fallen-due review recorded as continuing" means that the number of reviews in the hold's history recorded as continuing the hold is at least the number of reviews fallen due by today.

## Combinations

| Reviews fallen due by today | Reviews recorded as continuing | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 3 | 7 days |
| 4 | 4 | 7 days |
| 2 | 2 | 3 days |
| 0 | 0 | 3 days (no review has fallen due, and none falls short) |
| 3 | 2 | Nothing |
| 1 | 0 | Nothing |

**Example (hypothetical).** A hold started on 1 January; on 10 June one review (1 April) has fallen due and one review is recorded as continuing the hold. Every fallen-due review is accounted for, and they number fewer than 3: 3 calendar days are added.
